title: Huawei Cloud Ma Dao Fully Upgraded: The World's First HarmonyOS-Specific AI Coding Agent Launches, Providing a One-Stop Solution from Idea to Release

content_html:
Huawei Cloud CodeArts Code Intelligence Agent has taken a crucial step towards HarmonyOS developers, launching three core capabilities at once: the HarmonyOS coding large model, CodeArts HarmonyOS intelligent agent, and the HarmonyOS Developer Practice Center. The official positioning is strong: it is the world's first and currently the only AI coding intelligent agent specifically designed for the HarmonyOS ecosystem, equivalent to providing HarmonyOS developers with a digital partner that follows them from start to finish.

The key player is the HarmonyOS coding large model. It relies on the enhanced training system of HarmonyOS, and holds an advantage in several dimensions that developers care most about, including training data, code generation, compilation pass rate, and Token consumption. It is already available for use. The accompanying HarmonyOS coding intelligent agent extends its capabilities across the entire application development process, featuring innovative features such as DevEco CLI and various practical skills, making coding, debugging, and building no longer a series of fragmented manual operations.

To help newcomers get started quickly, the HarmonyOS Developer Practice Center provides practical case studies in multiple scenarios and cloud-based practice environments, effectively lowering the development threshold. The ultimate goal of this comprehensive upgrade is clear: to streamline the entire process for HarmonyOS developers from idea to app release, helping them overcome various challenges during development and truly improving efficiency.
